title: kit.toml setting names say nothing to a person
what: Plain names with units, chosen by the front (owner: "ты можешь перефразировать эти названия полей по своему"; owner can reverse): typed_only -> typed_agents_only (the owner's name); fork_limit -> no_session_copy_above_tokens; max_parallel -> max_agents_per_change; build_tier_opus = escalate|allow|deny -> opus_for_builders = "after_a_failure" | "always" | "never". Every key in the kit.toml setup writes gets a one-line comment saying what it does for the person; the other keys are read the same way and renamed where their name needs relay's internals. A migration renames them in existing kit.toml files with one line; old names are refused with the new name in the message.
why: Owner, 30 Oct, reading the kit.toml relay setup writes (shown on the setup walkthrough page): the [delegate] keys name how the code is built, carry no units and need relay's internals to read (principle 10: a message to the user that needs the program's internal names). Facts, 30 Oct: lib/relay_config.py:118-122 defaults typed_only = true, fork_limit = 100000 (tokens), max_parallel = 4, build_tier_opus = "escalate" (escalate | allow | deny); readers: lib/relay_config.py, lib/relay_analyze.py, plugins/delegate/hooks/route-guard.py; only relay is registered in projects.toml, so one existing kit.toml to migrate.
failing_case: The kit.toml `relay setup` writes holds [delegate] fork_limit = 100000 and build_tier_opus = "escalate" with no comment; the owner could not tell what build_tier_opus does.
pass_cases: setup writes the new names, each with a comment
an old kit.toml is migrated with one line
an old name left in a file is refused naming its new name
the route guard reads the new names
